authority: Existing immutable native bootstrap grants only. Root CPU0 sends to slot1 CPU0 for same-CPU transport or slot0 CPU1 for cross-CPU transport/service. Root and slot1 each hold authentic SEND to slot0 for two-requester cases. No raw handle transfer, grant widening or deployment configuration.
useful_operation: A real Submit/Wait/Collect request and checked reply/effect. Transport responder verifies payload and returns execution sequence; production counter uses its unchanged exact sixteen-byte Add/Get protocol.
outcomes: Record every offered attempt with exact request/client/stage/status. Exhausted is not a successful useful operation. Saturation requires exact queue-full rejection, successful drainage and subsequent service. Unexpected failure remains failure; no retries.

measurement.wall: CLOCK immediately before Submit to CLOCK after terminal Collect (or admission rejection); userspace envelope, not exact internal admission-to-terminal timestamps.
measurement.execution_window: CLOCK x2 client observation includes transition edges and stalls; not exclusive CPU or service execution.
measurement.read_window: CLOCK x3 measures READ_WINDOW body, not IPC execution.
measurement.throughput: Measured-phase useful successes only. Common start is after both requesters finish warmups and before peer GO reply. End is after peer DONE receipt (or final root sample for one requester), before bulk raw export. Includes GO/DONE control overhead; never invert median or sum overlapping intervals.
measurement.clock_calls: Start, immediately after Submit, and end after Collect/rejection: three common probes in both observer modes.
measurement.saturation_distributions: Report admitted A, refused B and recovered C separately; pooled successful A/C quantiles are supplemental heterogeneous distributions.

observer.contract: Identical useful requests, three common CLOCK calls and oracle. ON adds exactly one volatile store of the middle CLOCK ticks into actor-private memory before end CLOCK. OFF omits only this store. Incremental recorder cost, no exact subtraction.
observer.outcome_policy: Use all offered measured intervals with request/phase identities, never truncate successful populations. Differing outcome vectors make observer interpretation INCONCLUSIVE; even matching outcomes do not isolate CPU recorder cost.

sampling.phase: preregistered main campaign; no result asserted
sampling.order: pair0..11 outer, case0..11, DEV then PROD, OFF/ON on even pair and ON/OFF on odd pair
sampling.repeat_unit: fresh guest boot/pair; requests within a boot may correlate
sampling.stopping: Fixed attempts, no retry, selective omission, outlier deletion or historical reuse. Retain failed boots and source changes.
sampling.main_gate: Fixed plan after independently reviewed 96-boot pilot; no replacement, retries, selective omission or outcome-dependent stopping.
sampling.population: 36 total offered attempts across requesters. Two-requester cases split 18 each: two warmups and sixteen measured. Saturation has twelve cycles, each one admitted, one refused and one recovered request; first cycle is warmup.
sampling.conditioning: Fixed finite-session warmup, not a demonstrated steady-state stabilization criterion.
sampling.uncertainty: All twelve boot-pair differences/logratios, median and sorted third-to-tenth interval (0.96142578125 nominal conditional coverage for median under IID continuous paired observations); expose host drift assumptions, no simultaneous inference, p99 adequacy or superiority claim.

resources.boundary: No increase of any production buffer/stack/queue limit. Reports are exported outside individual latency envelopes.

admission: Existing Arena schemas, registry and assessor only. Preserve strict loss/sample/security gates. Ineligible or incomplete populations retain reasons; no fabricated successful samples or zeroed failures. Pilot alone never closes issue33 or yields an eligible Arena record.

request_deadline.policy: Existing native::rpc client policy, one counter-frequency interval from start; not a kernel synchronization timeout or performance allowance.
request_deadline.absolute: start.ticks + start.frequency, checked arithmetic; reconstruct from retained raw start and frequency
request_deadline.failure: Every expiration and stage/status retained; no deadline increase or retries.

report.ordering: Root records first, then peer records; each client retains chronological warmup prefix and all measured attempts. Saturation admits A, rejects B while A retained, then completes a fresh C; A/B envelopes deliberately overlap.
report.storage: Existing 2048-word kernel report capacity; bounded64word transport chunks with exact identity/order/end validation. No enlarged stack, logger or report buffer.

saturation_latency_scope: Admitted request A intentionally includes nested rejected B probes and ordinary feedback-release RPC before A Collect. This controlled saturation/drainage envelope is a separate workload, not an independent ordinary round-trip sample.
